text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is in its final 
stages. To make the most of this crucial 
period for the Umamusume, the Trainers 
support their training with everything 
they've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks in part to that, the Umamusume 
steadily improved their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume under Trainer Kashimoto 
spent a fulfilling training camp preparing 
for their autumn races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin also felt immense joy at 
the slight growth shown by Happy Meek, a 
late bloomer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Let's keep this momentum going—" With 
that resolve, the Trainers placed their 
trust in the wisdom of the Three 
Goddesses.
